package.name: yahboom_rosmaster_hw_bridge
package.description: Pragmatic ROS 2 hardware bridge for the Yahboom ROSMaster X3 Plus. Wraps the stock Rosmaster_Lib Python serial driver in FollowJointTrajectory action servers, a /joint_states publisher, and a cmd_vel/odom base driver. Targets the same MoveIt + perception pipeline that drives the Gazebo simulation, with no ros2_control plugin underneath.
